what: a gold hoe: a big flat blade, about a third of the canvas wide, set at a right angle across the top of the shaft and reading clearly at slot size, made of shiny lemon-gold with orange-brown shadows and small white glints, a gold collar with its own brown-gold outline, on a handle wrapped in red-brown leather with gold bands and a round gold pommel, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, tip at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner
